typedOwnership.panel: Framework-free snapshot uses public display config, keySet boolean, connected/usableSource facts and discriminated status. No actual API key or document content. Local/external children compose authored markup directly. Preserve cfg fallback/truthiness behavior in projection.
typedOwnership.stats: Loading/empty/loaded/error union; original modelLabel/backend/speed/plural/performance-note facts projected once; raw model retained solely for original title. Controller owns recordLocalLensStats/updateLensStatus and async service calls.
typedOwnership.documents: Ordered source label/chunks/action attribute snapshot. No sorting/truncating/parsing/coercion changes. Authored typed rows; no raw HTML.
typedOwnership.library: Typed option array with exact selected flags and empty/error labels; ordered model cards with existing computed recommendation/profile/language/download/notes, no hardware capability inference inside components.
typedOwnership.modalAndPill: Existing DOM host creation/lifetime/controller mutation remains; authored header/body/pill descendants render without permanent extra wrappers. Class helper applied to owned existing host. Progress events still update exact nodes/hidden/value/max/text/disabled fields.
